changes_vs_current: SCOPE. Brands are the main items, because that is what people say and what every source measures. Flavor lines go in as aliases of their brand, not as separate items: Cool Ranch and Nacho Cheese go into Doritos, and Flamin' Hot/Hot Cheetos go into Cheetos. No source measures them apart from the brand (Wikipedia: Flamin' Hot Cheetos 20.7k views vs Cheetos 207k; Cool Ranch has no article). Separate items would let one answer hit two spots and confuse players. The kinds people name without a brand are kept: Popcorn, Pretzels, Pork Rinds, Kettle Chips. Brands that are really one of those kinds go in as aliases so there are no near-duplicates: Smartfood, Orville Redenbacher and Pop Secret go into Popcorn; Snyder's, Rold Gold and Dot's go into Pretzels; Kettle Brand and Lay's Kettle Cooked go into Kettle Chips. Category words ('potato chips', 'tortilla chips') are not items. Flavor-only answers are left out too: Salt & Vinegar, Sour Cream & Onion and BBQ appeared only in Utz's 2026 flavor survey (Original 18.7, SC&O 18.5, BBQ 17.8, S&V 13.3), which ranks flavors, not snacks. Nuts (Planters) and sweet popcorn (Cracker Jack) are out. Veggie Straws had no measurable data (no Wikipedia article, no YouGov page found), so it was dropped. RAW AVERAGE ORDER (7 people sources, missing = list length + 5): 1 Doritos 3.43 (7 sources), 2 Lay's 4.29, 3 Cheetos 4.93, 4 Pringles 5.50, 5 Fritos 7.86, 6 Goldfish 8.71, 7 Tostitos 9.14, 8 Ruffles 9.79, 9 Cheez-It 10.14, 10 Takis 10.71 (3 sources), 11 Ritz 10.71 (2), 12 Popcorn 11.71, 13 Utz 12.00, 14 Chex Mix 12.07, 15 Pretzels 12.14, 16 Sun Chips 12.43, 17 Pork Rinds 13.00, 18 Kettle 13.14, 19 Bugles 13.29, 20 Corn Nuts 13.71, 21 Cape Cod 14.00, 22 Funyuns 14.00, 23 Zapp's 14.29, 24 Pirate's Booty 14.57; near misses Wise 15.0, Smartfood 15.14 (now a Popcorn alias), Gardetto's 15.14, Herr's 15.29, Combos 15.57. GUT-CHECK MOVES. All 12 gut-check items are in the raw top 15. Pretzels (raw 15) moves up to 12. It is the #4 Wikipedia page of the whole pool (253k), it is a $2.8B Circana category growing 5.5% (52 weeks to May 18, 2025, Snack & Bakery), and no source puts it lower: brand surveys simply don't ask about it. Ritz (raw 11) drops to 13 and Popcorn moves from 12 to 11 as a result. Ritz is a cracker that a player is less likely to give for 'chips & salty snacks', though YouGov rates it highly (76%). Utz (raw 13) drops to 17. Its Wikipedia rank is inflated by a company/stock article, and its YouGov popularity is only 48% with 73% fame, which makes it a regional brand. Chex Mix, Sun Chips and Kettle Chips each move up one spot as a result. Ruffles (gut 5, data 8) and Takis (gut 7, data 10) stay where the data puts them, inside the top 12. MOVES VS CURRENT LIST (Oct 7). 'Doritos Nacho Cheese' becomes 'Doritos' and stays #1. Cool Ranch Doritos (was 12) is folded into it as an alias. 'Lay's Classic' becomes 'Lay's' and stays #2. Cheetos moves up 4 to 3 and absorbs Flamin' Hot Cheetos (was 13). Pringles moves down 3 to 4: it leads both YouGov chip waves on positive opinion and search interest, but loses to Doritos/Lay's/Cheetos in favorite-pick and state-favorite data. Fritos moves up 9 to 5, backed by 5 sources (YouGov 73%, 3 HubScore states, Mashed write-ins). Goldfish stays 6. Tostitos moves up 11 to 7 (YouGov 69-72%, Shane Co #2). Ruffles moves down 5 to 8. Cheez-It moves down 7 to 9. Takis moves down 8 to 10 (Wikipedia 118k, Piper teens 4%, Texas search leader). Popcorn moves down 10 to 11. Pretzels moves up 18 to 12. Ritz is new at 13. Chex Mix moves up 19 to 14 (YouGov 67%, 3 HubScore states). Sun Chips moves up 16 to 15. Kettle Chips moves up 14 to 16. Utz is new at 17. Pork Rinds are new at 18. Bugles moves up 5 to 19. Cape Cod stays 20. Funyuns moves down 17 to 21 (Wikipedia 41k only; no YouGov page found). Corn Nuts are new at 22. Zapp's is new at 23 (Wikipedia 25k plus Louisiana search leader). Pirate's Booty is new at 24. Dropped: Cool Ranch Doritos and Flamin' Hot Cheetos (now aliases), Salt and Vinegar, Sour Cream & Onion and BBQ Chips (flavors, not snacks), and Veggie Straws (no data). Positions 12-24 were no-data carryovers. Each now has at least one source that was actually read.
confidence: Top 4 (Doritos, Lay's, Cheetos, Pringles): high. Every source has them near the top, though their exact order changes from source to source. Positions 5-10 (Fritos, Goldfish, Tostitos, Ruffles, Cheez-It, Takis): medium. Each has 3-5 sources, but they spread widely (Goldfish and Cheez-It lead with teens and sit mid-pack in YouGov; Takis has no YouGov page). Positions 11-16 (Popcorn, Pretzels, Ritz, Chex Mix, Sun Chips, Kettle Chips): medium-low. Popcorn and Pretzels rest on Wikipedia plus Circana category sales and the gut check. Positions 17-24: low. Most rest on one or two sources, mainly Wikipedia pageviews, and the order among them is close to noise. Near misses: Wise, Gardetto's, Herr's, Combos, Wheat Thins, Cheez Doodles, Veggie Straws, Doritos/Cheetos flavor lines (aliased). Could not read: the full YouGov list past the top 20 (the 'load more' API call was not allowed, so individual brand pages were used, and the Takis, Funyuns, Bugles and Orville Redenbacher pages 404'd), Statista chip-purchase charts (403), Circana brand-level sales (only company/segment totals are public), Google Trends directly (used published Trends-based studies instead), and Ranker (not attempted; blocked for bots). No current adult unaided 'favorite chip' poll with a full brand list was found. The closest were Utz/Censuswide 2026 (flavors and kinds only; potato chips 35.6% as the one salty snack) and Kellanova's 2025 road-trip survey (Cheez-It and Pringles named on top, no numbers). The two YouGov sources share a panel, so the method is somewhat correlated.
